content.short: oSnap is a decentralized governance tool that helps DAOs streamline their governance processes.
content.description: oSnap tackles the challenge of low voter participation in DAOs by enabling gas-free voting, which helps boost overall engagement by 10x. Proposals are vetted for validity using a trusted UMA oracle, ensuring decisions are grounded in accurate data while reducing reliance on centralized multisigs. The solution adds a security layer by allowing existing multisigs to approve urgent transactions or reject proposals, thereby reducing censorship risk and strengthening the integrity and effectiveness of DAO governance.
